title: FAA UAP reports, batch 02 (237UAP00030 - 237UAP00055)
doc_notes: This document is a batch of FAA Skywatch incident reports, most of which describe distant sightings or radar anomalies, with one report of a close-approach encounter.

encounters.summary: Pilot reported a red orb with black markings passing within 200 feet laterally and 30 feet above the aircraft.
encounters.quote: passed within very close proximity to the ACFT
